title: Parts of scenic SR 153 in southern Utah washed out, forcing UDOT to close it indefinitely
summary: A highway that cuts through Beaver Canyon is now closed indefinitely after Sunday's floods washed away segments of the road.

title: Ogden City Council tabs former state lawmaker Jeremy Peterson to fill vacancy
summary: The Ogden City Council picked former state lawmaker Jeremy Peterson to replace Shaun Myers, who will be stepping down from his council post.
